status: Defect and correction proven; pure candidate acceptance in progress
root_cause: EndpointDriver captured one timestamp before drain; later poll_recv batches reused it while concurrent connectiondrivers transmitted packets. An ACK could then predate the packet it acknowledges; saturating subtraction hides negative RTT aszero.
correction: Read runtime.now immediately after each successful socket.poll_recv and remove stale timestamp plumbing. One clock sample per batch, no per-datagram fields or altered resource limits.
